answer: Rewards can be capped per funding source. Every new agent must be seeded by a traceable deposit, and all agents tracing back to one source share a single reward slot, like fish in one lagoon sharing the same food. A sybil farm hoping its clones each find their own opal must fund each one through separate, unlinked wallets with real money, and any reuse merges them into one reef that earns as one agent.
